blocks.title: Buffer solution
blocks.text: Woh solutions jo thora sa acid ya base shamil karne par apne pH ki tabdeeli ka muqabla (resist) karte hain buffer solutions kehlate hain. Un ka ek khaas mustaqil pH hota hai, aur un ka pH dilute karne par ya lambe arse tak rakhne par nahi badalta.

Buffer solutions zyada tar do madde mila kar banaye jate hain. Kamzor acid ko strong base ke saath us ke salt se milana tezabi buffer deta hai jis ka pH 7 se kam hai; acetic acid aur sodium acetate behtareen misalon mein se hai. Kamzor base ko strong acid ke saath us ke salt se milana basic buffer deta hai jis ka pH 7 se zyada hai; NH4OH aur NH4Cl behtareen misalon mein se hai.

CH3COOH aur CH3COONa ke tezabi buffer par ghaur karein. Acetic acid, kamzor electrolyte, bohat kam dissociate hota hai: CH3COOH(aq) + H2O(l) se CH3COO-(aq) + H3O+(aq). Jab sodium acetate, ek strong electrolyte, shamil kiya jaye, CH3COONa(aq) se CH3COO-(aq) + Na+(aq), to CH3COO- ke common ion effect se CH3COOH ka dissociation dab jata hai. Jaise mazeed CH3COONa shamil hota hai, shamil shuda acetate CH3COOH ka dissociation ghatata aur solution ka pH barhta hai; sodium acetate ke muqable acetic acid ki concentration jitni zyada, pH utna kam. Table 9.4 dikhati hai ke mixture ka pH kaise barqarar rehta hai.

blocks.caption: 0.10 mol dm-3 acetic acid mein acetate ions shamil karne ka asar (Table 9.4)

blocks.alt: Oopar baen: NaCl aur HCl ke saath common ion effect aur teen mazeed misalein. Oopar daen: 0.10 M acetic acid ke pH ka bar chart 0 se 0.15 mol dm-3 acetate concentrations par 2.89 se 4.92 tak barhta hua, saath girta hua dissociation feesad. Darmiyani patti: Henderson ka muadla pH = pKa soorat ke saath. Neeche baen: PbSO4 aur PbCl2 ka Ksp aur Ca(OH)2 solubility sample. Neeche daen: PbCrO4 par common ion effect, ionic product table aur CaSO4 precipitation misal.
blocks.caption: Common ion effect, buffer amal, Henderson ka muadla aur solubility product (topics 9.6 se 9.8.1, Table 9.4 aur ionic product table ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Aisa ion shamil karna jo equilibrium pehle se paida karta hai us equilibrium ko peechhe dhakelta hai: HCl ka chloride brine se NaCl precipitate karta hai, aur acetate ions acetic acid ka dissociation 1.3 feesad se 0.012 feesad tak ghatate hain jabke pH 2.89 se 4.92 tak barhta hai. Banne wala mixture buffer hai: shamil H3O+ acetate le leta hai aur shamil OH- acetic acid, to pH mushkil se hilta hai, aur Henderson ka muadla woh pH pKa jama salt aur acid ke tanasub ka logarithm deta hai, dono barabar hon to pKa (4.74) ke barabar. Kam halne wale salts ke liye yahi khayal solubility product banta hai: Ksp ion concentrations ka hasil-e-zarb hai, har ek apne coefficient par uthai hui, yeh solubility muqarrar karta hai (calcium hydroxide ke liye 1.18 x 10^-2 mol dm-3), common ion us solubility ko ghatata hai, aur salt sirf tab precipitate hota hai jab ionic product Ksp se barh jaye.

blocks.text: Is qism ka buffer CH3COOH aur CH3COO- ka bara zakheera (reservoir) hai. Jab acid (H3O+ ions) shamil kiya jaye to ions CH3COO- se react kar ke acetic acid wapas dete hain, to pH taqreeban be-tabdeel rehta hai, kyunke CH3COOH, ek kamzor acid, ghair-dissociated rehna pasand karta hai. Isi tarah NH4Cl aur NH4OH ka buffer bahar se acid ya base shamil karne par pH aur pOH ki tabdeeli ka muqabla karta hai. Jab base (OH- ions) shamil kiya jaye to ions H3O+ se react kar ke H2O wapas dete hain aur pH phir taqreeban be-tabdeel rehta hai.

blocks.prompt: Wazahat karein ke acetate buffer NaOH ke chand qatron, aur HCl ke chand qatron, ke shamil hone ka muqabla kaise karta hai.
blocks.explanation: Shamil OH- zakheere ke ghair-dissociated acetic acid se react karta hai, CH3COOH + OH- se CH3COO- + H2O, to hydroxide pH barhane ke bajaye kharch ho jata hai. Shamil H+ acetate ions se react karta hai, CH3COO- + H+ se CH3COOH, to acid pH ghatane ke bajaye kharch ho jata hai. Sirf acid aur acetate ka tanasub thora badalta hai, aur pH bohat kam hilta hai.

items: Buffers thora acid ya base shamil karne aur dilute karne par pH ki tabdeeli ka muqabla karte hain: tezabi buffer = kamzor acid + us ka salt (CH3COOH / CH3COONa, pH 7 se kam); basic buffer = kamzor base + us ka salt (NH4OH / NH4Cl, pH 7 se zyada).
Acetate acetic acid ka dissociation dabata hai (Table 9.4: 1.3 se 0.012 feesad, pH 2.89 se 4.92); shamil H3O+ CH3COO- se hat-ta hai, shamil OH- CH3COOH se.
